cohort: 152 Caucasian pregnant women classified as having either preterm birth (<=36 6/7 weeks, n = 61) or term birth (>=38 0/7 weeks, n = 91), excluding those with other major medical or obstetric conditions.
finding: The genera Veillonella, Prevotella, and Capnocytophaga in the maternal oral microbiome were associated with preterm birth, independent of clinically apparent infection, uterine anomalies, and other pregnancy complications.
gest_age: Preterm birth (<=36 6/7 weeks) or term birth (>=38 0/7 weeks)
